general.q: Which traditional British cheese can legally only be made in Derbyshire, Leicestershire, and Nottinghamshire?
general.why: Blue Stilton has protected status, meaning even the village of Stilton in Cambridgeshire cannot legally produce it.

general.q: Which African country was historically known in the English-speaking world as Abyssinia?
general.why: Abyssinia was the official name used in English for the Ethiopian Empire until the mid-20th century.

general.q: Which planet in our solar system has the shortest day, rotating once every ten hours?
general.why: Despite being the largest planet in our solar system, gas giant Jupiter spins on its axis in under 10 hours.

general.q: Which organ in the human body produces the hormone insulin?
general.why: The pancreas secretes insulin from clusters of cells called the islets of Langerhans to regulate blood sugar levels.

general.q: Which Japanese word translates literally into English as 'empty orchestra'?
general.why: 'Kara' means empty and 'oke' is short for okesutora (orchestra), referring to the missing vocal track.

pop.q: In the sitcom Peep Show, what is the name of Mark Corrigan's charismatic boss at JLB Credit?
pop.why: Alan Johnson, played by Paterson Joseph, is Mark's idol and boss at JLB Credit.

pop.q: Which chocolate bar was advertised from 2002 with the famous slogan 'It's not for girls!'?
pop.why: Yorkie used the controversial slogan on packaging and adverts from 2002 until 2011.

pop.q: In the original 1997 video game Grand Theft Auto, which of these was NOT one of the three featured cities?
pop.why: The 1997 original featured Liberty City, Vice City and San Andreas. Bullworth was in Bully.

pop.q: Which late 1980s monster puppet toy was sold inside a cardboard box styled like a cage with plastic bars?
pop.why: Boglins were rubber hand puppets sold in crate-like boxes with plastic bars.

pop.q: In the BBC comedy series The Office, what is the name of the paper merchant where David Brent is manager?
pop.why: David Brent is the regional manager of the Slough branch of paper merchant Wernham Hogg.

music.q: What was the title of Coldplay's debut studio album, released in 2000?
a: A Rush of Blood to the Head
music.why: 'Parachutes' included hit singles like 'Yellow' and 'Trouble', launching the band to global fame.

music.q: Which Norwegian synth-pop band had a UK Number 1 hit in 1985 with 'Take On Me'?
music.why: The song is famous for its revolutionary pencil-sketch animation music video.

music.q: Which electronic music duo released their influential debut album 'Homework' in 1997?
music.why: 'Homework' featured classic club tracks like 'Da Funk' and 'Around the World'.

music.q: Who had the UK Christmas Number 1 single in 1992 with 'I Will Always Love You'?
music.why: The song spent 10 consecutive weeks at UK Number 1 after featuring on The Bodyguard soundtrack.

music.q: Which rock band released the critically acclaimed album 'Rumours' in 1977?
music.why: 'Rumours' became one of the best-selling albums of all time, featuring hits like 'Go Your Own Way'.

mix.q: Which British synth-pop duo had a UK number one hit in 1986 with 'West End Girls'?
mix.why: West End Girls was originally released in 1984 before being re-recorded and hitting number one in 1985.

mix.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold on the periodic table?
mix.why: Au comes from the Latin word for gold, aurum, which translates as 'shining dawn'.

mix.q: In the classic BBC sitcom Fawlty Towers, what was the first name of Basil's wife?
mix.why: Sybil Fawlty was played by Prunella Scales across both series of the sitcom.

mix.q: Which actor played Morpheus in the original 1999 sci-fi film The Matrix?
mix.why: Laurence Fishburne turned down several other roles before taking the iconic part of Morpheus.

mix.q: Which synth-pop group had the UK Christmas number one single in 1981 with Don't You Want Me?
mix.why: It was the biggest-selling UK single of 1981 despite singer Philip Oakey's initial dislike of the mix.

mix.q: What is the official capital city of Australia?
mix.why: Canberra was selected as the compromise capital between rival cities Sydney and Melbourne in 1908.

mix.q: In the classic arcade fighting game Street Fighter II, which country is Blanka from?
mix.why: Blanka is a feral fighter from the Brazilian rainforest with green skin and orange hair.

mix.q: Which rock band released the groundbreaking 1991 album Nevermind?
mix.why: Nevermind brought alternative rock to the mainstream and sold over 30 million copies worldwide.

mix.q: Which type of pastry is traditionally used to make profiteroles and éclairs?
mix.why: Choux pastry relies on high moisture content to create steam and puff up during baking.

mix.q: What was the name of the fictional high school in the American teen sitcom Saved by the Bell?
mix.why: Bayside High was located in Pacific Palisades, California, led by Principal Mr Belding.
